description: This file defines a Dart class `NewsApiClient` responsible for fetching top news headlines from the NewsAPI. It includes error handling via the `NewsApiException` class, manages HTTP requests using `HttpClient`, constructs request URIs with parameters, and processes the JSON response into `NewsArticle` model instances.

classes.name: NewsApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to NewsAPI requests.

classes.name: NewsApiClient
classes.description: Client class responsible for making requests to the NewsAPI, fetching top headlines, handling errors, and managing the underlying HTTP connection.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches top headlines for a specified country and optional category, returning a list of `NewsArticle` instances.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the underlying HTTP client connection.
